unit.why: A single narrative: the Berdichever rabbi visits the gaon of P"B, teaches him about blessing before food, solves a difficult Tosafot through a psalm and a heavenly revelation, and is then honoured by the gaon. It ends with a homily the rabbi gave there.

stories.start_quote: סיפר הגאוה"צ מוה' אברהם יודא הכהן זצ"ל
stories.summary_en: R. Levi Yitzhak of Berdichev, exhausted and hungry, arrives at the house of the gaon of P"B, who is puzzling over a difficult Tosafot. He will not eat until his host has blessed the food, then recites Psalm 24 in ecstasy, receives the explanation from the Tosafist who comes down from heaven, and wins the gaon's recognition; the two then discuss a Talmudic saying, which he interprets homiletically.
